# Distinct game absorption contract

## Actual interface and consumers

Use declarative simulation commands/effects, current player native inventory/vitals/equipment, actual people/site/rights and played clock. The executable host must call `commitSimulationCommand`, return its staged native plan, and let the caller use `persistExpansion`. It must never publish independently. Facts must stay pure and import neither the simulation executor nor native/UI modules, so the shared scheduler can recompute them at admission and completion without a cycle. Native bindings must pass complete current `gameplay`, `vitals`, `equipment`, `external` and location context.

A timed job reserves only its own costs now. Declare exact cancellation/refund and live completion support. Actual tools consumed/reserved at admission must use the existing returned-item accounting and, if required at completion, an exact transient popped-job binder supplied by the scheduler. Existing typed actor/world facts, command completions and attributed knowledge are preferred to a new mirrored module state. Reading or rendering grants nothing. Player records only project their own acquired observations; NPC eligibility facts are never surfaced as omniscient stock/body reports.

Provide actual connected prerequisites, useful alternatives, material/effort/time costs, native output/use and retained aftermath in the same selected feature. No empty registrations, unused calculator or automatically gifted starting stock. Original fiction/numbers are reversible proposals, distinct from source mechanics. Retain original opening, existing milestone, private saves/source libraries/LICENSE and upstream attribution.

## Compatibility choice

Selected new content is absent and inert until an explicit player action. Retain existing owners and earlier frozen jobs; no retroactive receipts or rewards. Once content is chosen, bind exact typed keys, causal receipts and live job invariants in a pure validator. The shared integrator decides the enclosing supported reader and propagates its existing optional-domain compatibility without changing old semantic versions. No competing global schema decision is made here.

## Evidence and remaining integration

Allowed checks: source syntax, imports, definition/link inspection, then shared-owner matching build only after an explicit live transfer. Current policy defers all unit/browser/gameplay/save/reload/import/failure/keyboard/regression/director suites. Changed gameplay stays **implemented-unverified**. Evidence must distinguish authored leaf source, registered native/UI consumers, matching bundle and actual later acceptance.

Pending parent bindings: definition aggregate, fresh facts in simulation_effects, optional validator in expansion_engine, current native context and router in main, shared feature presentation/cancellation/legibility types, notebook job route, exact scheduler completion support/returned inputs, source-to-bundle build. An inspectable exact patch will replace this provisional anchor list once the selected feature exists. The full objective remains open while native integration is reserved; module completion is only a checkpoint.

## Selected original player journey

After explicitly opening the existing fieldcraft workshop, ask Eda about one old packing case. She owns two clouded-batch charges and two gummed packing pins, provisioned once on this separate agreement. Purchases cost two coins per vial or one per pin and transfer her real stock into the native bag while crediting her purse. The disclosed closed catalogue contains reed oil or gum wash; item names expose no actual identity.

A two-minute, one-stamina knife-edge trial consumes one charge and leaves the exact dull knife unchanged. That negative result alone identifies nothing. A separately acquired existing pale-oil assay OR useful oil sharpening record supplies the control. A one-minute comparison freezes that actual source receipt into its ordinary knowledge effect, then records an inference only after both pieces of evidence exist. Evidence order is flexible. Later oil uses may update their own identity receipt without erasing the comparison's retained source. A completed failed attempt stays paid. Cancellation or lost current body/site/tool support returns exact held inputs and teaches nothing.

Alternatives: a three-minute, one-stamina direct sample examination spends a charge and identifies through observation; two-minute, one-stamina washing spends a charge and gummed pin and recovers one existing fitting pin through useful observation; five-minute, two-stamina scraping uses an owned dull knife spine and returns that same knife plus one recovered pin, without a charge or substance learning. The existing pin + sound stave + set resin kit action is the connected native output consumer, followed by actual kit reserve/orders/preparation/trade. No new buyer, power, source faculty or independent recipe engine. Leaving the supply alone accepts no obligation.

This deliberately adapts the packet's reversible four-wash/rubbing/buyer proposal into a two-candidate bench case using existing consumers. Source mechanism preserved: a paid ineffectual attempt does not grant identity by itself; separately acquired constraints can single out a kind, changing subsequent known use, with the failed sample still spent. The new durable negative ledger and later comparison are our extension, not a Brogue replay feature. All fictional substances/case/pins/prices/durations remain original proposals.

## Exact bindings

1. **Definitions and native reconstruction:** import `gameAbsorptionAssayDefinitions` in `simulation_content.js` and append its ten commands to the existing aggregate. Register its two item specs once in `data/expedition_items.js` through existing `OtherItem`/`item_templates`. No new world/site/person/power/source/controller is created on import. The existing fieldcraft workshop and fitting bench are the prerequisites.
2. **Admission, scheduler and compatibility:** join pure `gameAbsorptionAssayFacts(state,context,registry)` in `simulation_effects.js`. Admit only this new group to existing `reservationReturns1` handling in `simulation.js`. At popped-job completion, pass that exact group job as transient `gameAbsorptionReservation`; facts validate its revision/cause/site reservation/costs/effects/participants/support before treating the held knife as present. Add `validateGameAbsorptionAssay` beside existing optional validators in `expansion_engine.js`. Existing jobs/schemas/owners keep their exact meaning.
3. **Player command and one publisher:** wrap `featureWaveContext` with the new current-context binder; route explicit `game_absorption_assay` controls to `commitGameAbsorptionAssayCommand`. Route this group's cancellation to `cancelGameAbsorptionAssayJob`. Both return ordinary staged plans and go through existing `persistExpansion`. The comparison host freezes the actual prior oil control into its standard one-minute job's `knowledge.control` effect before publication; generic direct command/program execution is not a supported comparison route. No new work plan/controller/routine is registered.
4. **Native stock validation and save readers:** call the pure validator with actual staged `gameplay` in `persistExpansion`. On loading, validate the raw native player inventory rows after `loadExpansionState` and before native reconstruction/publication, using their existing `{key: row.count}` representation. New stable item/command IDs require the matching updated fork; earlier readers are not a supported roundtrip. No global version is invented by these leaves. The enclosing current integrator owns schema11 admission and its earlier optional-domain compatibility.
5. **Actual UI and build:** append `gameAbsorptionAssayPresentation(...).sections` to `feature_expansion_wave_host`; include this group's live job in the existing Notebook Here attention route. Compose `projectGameAbsorptionAssayItemView` with the existing pale-vial projector in `display.nativeItemView`, reusing the current expansion-state reader. Keep generic ID/count/quality/custody and existing empty-vial view intact. After explicit ownership transfer and refreshed shared inputs, apply/reconcile these bindings, run permitted syntax/import/definition/link/build checks, and record matching bundle/source-map hashes. No unit/browser/gameplay/save/failure/keyboard/director suites in this wave.

## Concrete journeys for the later review

The former oil control may be acquired before or after a clouded charge's failed edge trial. Negative evidence alone retains two candidates. With actual oil evidence, the pure reducer leaves one candidate; the one-minute comparison separately records the inference, preserving its pre-comparison source snapshot even when later oil applications update their own receipt. No charge or edge improvement is restored by deduction.

Direct sample examination or useful pin washing identifies through observation; ordinary scraping costs more time/stamina and no charge or identity. Each completed or pending use is bounded by actual purchases. Exact tool/empty-container returns are not fresh native acquisitions. Clean pins use the existing `nethack_fieldcraft.pin_kit` costs (pin + sound stave + set resin + effort/time), then existing kit reserve/orders/preparation/trade. This adaptation selects no new rubbing/buyer/terrain system from the source proposal.
